title: Pet Adoption: Esperanza, Hopeful and Gentle - NewsBreak
text:
By Amelie Coghlan ,
9 hours ago MyRye.com features dogs and cats that are up for adoption by Pet Rescue, a no kill pet shelter in Harrison. Adult size: Small (35 lbs & under) Esperanza is an 8-month-old Staffordshire Terrier mix with the most beautiful hazel eyes, adorable floppy ears, and a stunning orange coat that perfectly matches her warm spirit. Her name, Esperanza is the Spanish word for “hope” and couldn’t suit her better. When she was found, she was severely underweight and clearly had not been receiving the care she deserved. Despite her difficult start, this sweet little girl has shown incredible resilience. She is now eating well, keeping her meals down, and growing stronger every day. Esperanza is great with other dogs and loves people. She is a gentle, puppy who is still learning that the world can be a safe and loving place. She will thrive with a patient family willing to give her the time, kindness, and TLC she needs. With her soulful eyes, loving heart, and remarkable journey of recovery, Esperanza is a beautiful reminder that hope can change everything. She’s ready for a second chance and a forever home where she can finally know the love she has always deserved. Read full article
